definitions.explanation: Woven or knitted material used to make clothing or other items.
A mixture of flour and liquid used for baking.
A person's true personality without pretense.

examples.japanese: この{生地|きじ}は{柔|やわ}らかい。
パンの{生地|きじ}を{こねる|こねる}。

notes:
{生地|きじ} has multiple meanings depending on context.

FABRIC MEANING:
- {生地|きじ}を{選|えら}ぶ (to choose fabric)
- {綿|めん}{生地|きじ} (cotton fabric)
- {絹|きぬ}{生地|きじ} (silk fabric)

DOUGH MEANING:
- {生地|きじ}を{こねる|こねる} (to knead dough)
- パンの{生地|きじ} (bread dough)
- ピザの{生地|きじ} (pizza dough)

TRUE NATURE MEANING:
- {生地|きじ}が{出|で}る (true nature comes out)
- {生地|きじ}を{見|み}せる (to show one's true colors)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生地|きじ}: fabric, dough
- {布|ぬの}: cloth (general term)
- {素材|そざい}: material (broader term)
